Discontinuous catenary systems use overhead electrified lines along certain segments of the network and alternative propulsion, e.g., battery locomotives, between these electrified sections. Japan Railway Association has been operating a discontinuous battery-catenary system for a section of their passenger rail since 2014. However, no known discontinuous catenary systems are currently in operation for freight.
